Messages.Author: Chris.QJ
Messages.Body:
hi

before i start with my impressions, i would like to thank Carl and his
team for a well organized event.

The opening party was very cool, good music, nice decoration, lots of
posters, and cards everywhere on the bar. unfortunately i missed the
show, but i was told it was great!

the location for the EC was chosen well, good atmosphere, nice
decoration, an an aire of the old world, monarchs, and a haven for
toreador and ventrue ;-)

i think the organisation, table seating, and so on, went quite
smoothly, considering the 115 participants. on the second day there
was quite a delay for the side events, but again, kudos to the
organizational team for finding a place for everyone, and managing 6
events at the same time.

as for the qualifier:
i failed horribly, as i seem to have a golden hand for picking the
deck to play for each event i take part in.
i played a toreador anson+anneke vote deck with 10 aching beauty's,
which normally does quite well.

round 1
anti vote prey with arika, elder kindred network and kindred coercion.
i played only two votes during the whole of the game. one krc which
cost me 5 pool, and one ancient influence which my predator was nice
enough not to ekn/kc, cant imagine why ;-)
well 0 points for me, and a game win for arika an her pals.

round 2
i bring out anson and sing a song to him:
"assamites to the left of me, assamites to the right, and here i am
stuck in the middle with you"
anson got reduced to 1 blood by a .44 and a blur, and tegiryus killed
him off with the fang.
a tablesplit deal was thwarted by my grandprey threatening to oust
himself, and so i was killed the normal way.
0 points, tegiryius i think took the gamewin

round 3
yippie, i love to be a speedbump to etrius bleeding for 8 about 5
times, deflect 3, golconda anson, die horribly.
0 points

sing the tripple zero blues, baby!!!

well, whatever, it was fun playing, and a good atmosphere with no
ruleslawyering and no mystic moves by any player.

second day:teamplay
i teamed up with marcus mock, and we went on to take 2 tables.
8 teams took part, and only one team managed to take 3 gamewins so we
decided to name this team the winner, and go on with some friendly
games, as we did not want to roll a dice between 3 other teams that
scored 2 gws.

i also me a whole buch of nice players, talked a lot of shop and
basically had a great time.

all in all a great weekend an once again thanks to Carl and his team!

regards
Chris.QJ
